# Frozen commit subjects that already carried the review identity.
#
# Each line is one full commit id whose subject carries the identity and cannot
# be rewritten, because rewriting pushed history is forbidden outright. The
# list is a ratchet: the ceiling lives in `xtask/tools/src/audit_guard.rs`
# (`MAX_QUARANTINED_SUBJECTS`) and a third entry fails the gate. A stale entry
# (a commit whose subject no longer carries the identity) also fails, so the
# file only shrinks. Subjects are deliberately not copied here: they carried
# internal tracker ids and this repository does not hold those.
#
# Both commits below are the pair that replaced two production modules with
# placeholder text on 2026-11-20. The modules were restored byte-for-byte from
# their parents; the commit ids are what remains.
